comment: Read from the installed 2.0.5 build. Q111_process adds the control jack to the knob, clamps the total to the equivalent of ±5V and derives two complementary gains from it. In the Fade position output 2 is written as zero and input 1 and input 2 are mixed into output 1; the maker's tooltip for the mode switch calls it Polarity Switch while the panel prints MODE, and its two positions are configured as Pan and Fade.
